verdict.rationale: No evidence of any versioning, review, or rollback capability for automations/workflows (e.g., automation rules, bank rules, invoice reminders) within QuickBooks Online; the only related mention is generic 'backup and restore to undo mistakes' at the account/data level, not automation-specific version control. Missing for 10: automation version history, change review/audit trail for rules/workflows, and rollback mechanism specific to automations.
